verdicts.reason: The schema directly instructs "Group related tracked tasks under ## numbered headings", which matches the heading pattern.
The schema says "Each tracked task MUST be a checkbox: `- [ ] X.Y Task description`", which the regex encodes exactly.
The text says "Each task MUST state how to verify completion ... Put the verification in that task's checkbox description."
It follows from the same "Each task MUST state how to verify completion" line, but it duplicates schema-102.0.
The schema says "Each task group MUST verify its own work as it lands: run the existing repository tests ... or write a check script ... and run it."
The apply instruction says "work through pending tasks, mark complete as you go", which requires the tasks artifact to be updated during apply.
The text says "mark complete as you go ... leave that task unchecked with a one-line reason", which supports done-or-reasoned at should level.
The config directs to "list every capability under New Capabilities, including behavior a fix corrects".
The config says "and leave Modified Capabilities empty", which matches max 0 bullets in that section.
The config says "write every delta as `## ADDED Requirements` of a new capability", which supports added_only.
The instruction names the tool to use ("with the `openspec` command-line tool that is installed here"), which implicitly supports a successful openspec archive; it's already should-level, so keep.
The template guidance "Use kebab-case for path segments you introduce" and the "- `<capability-path>`:" format support a should-level kebab-case backticked bullet check.
